name: 条例が参照する法律の条項番号を変更
summary: 現在、条例第2条は、障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律の第5条第13項と第14項を参照しています。この議案で参照先をそれぞれ第14項と第15項に改め、公布の日から施行します。
changes: 条例第2条の参照先を第5条第14項と第15項に改める
why: 法律の改正に伴い、条例の規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes the article numbers in the law cited by the ordinance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Residential Homes for People with Intellectual Disabilities
en.summary: Article 2 of the ordinance currently refers to paragraphs 13 and 14 of Article 5 of the Act on Comprehensive Support for the Daily and Social Life of Persons with Disabilities. This bill changes those references to paragraphs 14 and 15, respectively. The ordinance will take effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Changes the references in Article 2 to paragraphs 14 and 15 of Article 5
en.why: The ward says this is to adjust the ordinance's provisions in response to an amendment to the law.
